title: Every numeric claim in the README appears in a generated artifact
why_not_a_generator: The README is authored prose, not generated output, so 'regenerates identically' is not a property it has. The plan's acceptance criterion is traceability, which is checkable in the direction that matters: the README is checked AGAINST the artifacts, which is what a reviewer does by hand. A generator would only guarantee the README matches whatever the generator was told.
